text: manmathe ca hrdi hantum udyate prositapramadayedam udyate nirdayena paradesasevina marisyatha hi tena mam vina anyadesaratir adya mucyatam sathava tava vadhuh kim ucyatam catakas ca trsito mbu yacate duhkhita pathika sa priya ca te ambudaih sikhigano vinadyate ka ratih priya maya vinadya te toyadagamakrsa ca sadya te durdharena madanena sadyate sokasagarajale ca patitam tvadgunasmaranam eva pati tam dravati ca kalusam jalam nadinam kim iti ca mam samaveksase na dinam gambhiramegharasitavyathita kadaham jahyam sakhi priyaviyogajasokadaham

snippet: madanasya kṛte niketanānāṃ pratibhānty adya vanāni ketanānām tvaṃ mañjarībhiḥ pravaro vanānāṃ netrotsavaś cāsi sayauvanānām kuṭaja kiṃ kusumair avahasyate praṇipatāmi ca duṣprahasya te tava puṣpanirīkṣitāpadehaṃ visṛjeya
status: Sanskrit chunk (verbatim edition span; verse label 10-18)
text: madanasya krte niketananam pratibhanty adya vanani ketananam tvam manjaribhih pravaro vananam netrotsavas casi sayauvananam kutaja kim kusumair avahasyate pranipatami ca dusprahasya te tava puspaniriksitapadeham visrjeyam sahasaiva nipa deham madhunah samaveksya kalatam bhramaras cumbati yuthikalatam salilair vihatam rajah ksitau ravicandrav api nopalaksitau navambumattah sikhino nadanti meghagame kundasamanadanti sendrayudhas ca jalado dya rasann ibhanam samrambham avahati bhudharasannibhanam paridhiraravam jalam darisu prapaty adbhutarupasundarisu

text: utkanthayanti pathikan jaladah svanantah soko vivardhati ca tadvinatasv anantah ratyutsavam priyatamaih saha manayanti meghagamam priyasakhi svasamanayanti jiyeya yena kavina yamakaih parena tasmai vaheyam udakam ghatakarparena
